sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Bank cash register is a Loot Container in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: Bigger than the standard Cash register, has a 3x3 grid that spawns stacks of Roubles, Dollars and Euros.

sections.heading: Location
sections.text: In the Tarbank on Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Loot Table
sections.text:
| Icon | Type |
| Roubles | Money |
| Dollars | Money |
| Euros | Money |
| GP coin | Money |
| TarCoin | Money |
